prompt: Create a high-fashion editorial runway photograph of a tall young blonde woman with windblown shoulder-length hair walking confidently down a modern city street between dark glass skyscrapers. She wears an avant-garde couture dress inspired by ikebana and molecular sculpture: a deep midnight-blue glossy bodice with a sheer translucent teal-blue floor-length skirt, high front slit revealing one leg, delicate strappy silver heels, and a halo of intricate thin transparent and metallic wires swirling around her torso and hips. The dress includes exactly three main visible material zones: a dark reflective structured chest piece, a fitted semi-sheer blue mesh body, and a flowing transparent teal skirt. Add exactly about 45 visible pearl-like glass spheres and droplets attached to the wire structure, varying in size from tiny beads to marble-sized orbs, colored clear, pale green, aqua, and deep blue, with tiny sparkling nodes scattered through the lattice. The wire-and-orb arrangement should resemble a living floral arrangement or scientific molecule cloud, extending mostly to the model’s right side and around her waist, with long looping arcs behind her shoulder and down toward the hem. Use midnight blue, teal, pale green, aqua, and clear glass. Background: urban financial district, blurred pedestrians in dark suits, tall reflective buildings, bright daylight with strong side lighting and shallow depth of field. Camera: full-body vertical fashion shot, low-to-eye-level perspective, 85mm editorial lens look, crisp model and dress, creamy bokeh background, realistic skin texture, cinematic highlights on glass spheres, motion in hair and sheer fabric. Mood: futuristic couture fashion show on the street, elegant, surreal, luminous, no text, no watermark.

promptZh: 创作一张高规格时尚编辑秀场照片，拍摄一位高挑的 留着齐肩风吹发型的年轻金发女性，自信地走在现代城市街道上，背景是深色的玻璃摩天大楼。她身着一件灵感源自插花艺术与分子雕塑的前卫高定礼服：深午夜蓝色的光泽紧身胸衣，搭配半透明的青蓝色拖地长裙，前部高开叉露出一条腿，脚蹬精致的银色绑带高跟鞋，躯干和臀部周围环绕着一圈错综复杂的透明细丝与金属丝。礼服包含三个主要可见材质区域：深色反光结构胸甲、贴身半透明蓝色网眼衣身，以及飘逸的透明青色裙摆。在金属丝结构上添加约 45 颗可见的珍珠状玻璃球和水滴，大小从微小珠子到弹珠大小不等，颜色为透明、淡绿、水蓝和深蓝，晶格间散布着微小的闪光节点。金属丝与球体的排列应类似于活体花艺或科学分子云，主要延伸至模特右侧及腰部周围，并有长弧线绕过肩部向下延伸至裙摆。使用 午夜蓝、青色、淡绿、水蓝和透明玻璃色。背景：城市金融区，模糊的深色西装行人，高大的反光建筑，明亮的日光，强烈的侧光，浅景深。相机：全身垂直时尚摄影，低至平视视角，85mm 编辑镜头感，模特与礼服清晰锐利，奶油般虚化的背景，真实的皮肤纹理，玻璃球上的电影级高光，头发与薄纱的动感。氛围：街头未来主义高定秀，优雅、超现实、明亮，无文字，无水印。
